behavior_constraints: ensemble create accepts a --weights <w1,w2,...> flag with comma-separated positive numbers
number of weights must equal number of models; otherwise exit 1 and print 'weight count mismatch'
any weight <= 0 causes exit 1 and message 'weights must be positive'
when --weights omitted, default weights are [1.0] repeated once per model
resolved weights array is always persisted in the config JSON, including the unweighted default case
config JSON includes a 'created' field (date string) and a 'weights' array
weighted average = sum(weight_i * output_i) / sum(weights); max and min strategies unchanged
on successful ensemble create, exit 0 and print a confirmation line containing the word 'created'
ensemble info <name> prints Name, Strategy, then each model one per line with '(weight: <w>)', then Created date
ensemble info for a missing ensemble exits 1 with message 'ensemble not found'
affected_prior: saveEnsembleConfig/loadEnsembleConfig (round 7) — config struct gains weights and created fields
combineEnsembleOutputs (round 7) — average strategy now applies weighted averaging
parseFlags, printUsage, main (round 7) — must dispatch new 'ensemble info' subcommand and accept --weights
entities.summary: This round reworks the ensemble config to support weighted averaging via a persisted weights array and created date, adds an 'ensemble info' command, and validates weights on creation.

instruction_head:
